method: LLDB visibility-policy arguments and SCShareableContent metadata inspection
finding: The desktop-sized Dock surface triggers the rectangle occlusion check although the selected browser content is visible.
resolution: Scrolling capture excludes Tinycast and Dock applications from its SCContentFilter; the visibility policy consumes the same excluded PIDs.
regression: The observed Dock case fails under the prior predicate. Excluded Dock passes, but an unexcluded Dock or another application at the same layer still pauses. An excluded target is rejected.
limitations: The final filter change has not yet completed native multi-frame capture and export.
Debugger inspection is not a memory benchmark.
